## About the Data

This project visualizes North Carolina election results, focusing on county-level shifts between the 2024 general election and the 2026 midterm election.

- **Source:** Official precinct- and county-level election returns from the [North Carolina State Board of Elections (NCSBE)](https://www.ncsbe.gov/).
- **Coverage:** Precinct vote totals aggregated to the county level for major statewide contests (such as the 2024 Presidential and 2026 U.S. Senate races).
- **Geographic Data:** North Carolina county boundaries provided via the `maps` package in R.
